question_cn: 2026 FIFA 世界杯 C 组头名（最终积分榜第 1）会是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team will finish first in Group C at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
one_liner_cn: 巴西 Elo 断层领先、约七成概率拿下 C 组头名，但多人伤缺加内马尔存疑，摩洛哥与阵容完整的苏格兰合计仍有约三成机会。
one_liner_en: Brazil's big Elo edge makes them roughly 70% to top Group C, but with several injuries and Neymar doubtful, Morocco and a fully fit Scotland together keep about a 30% chance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：巴西 1991（世界第 5）领先摩洛哥 1827、苏格兰 1782，10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟中 72.8% 拿下小组头名。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap: Brazil 1991 (world #5) vs Morocco 1827 and Scotland 1782; Brazil tops the group in 72.8% of 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 巴西阵容扰动：罗德里戈（ACL）与埃斯特旺伤缺、右后卫 Wesley 赛前伤退，内马尔 5 月底小腿伤使首战存疑——下调 2pp 转给阵容完整的苏格兰。
key_reasons.en: Brazil squad disruption: Rodrygo (ACL) and Estevao out, right-back Wesley withdrawn injured pre-tournament, and Neymar's late-May calf injury leaves the opener in doubt — 2pp moved to a fully fit Scotland.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥自身减员（阿格尔德、埃扎祖利赛前因伤退出，恩内斯里落选）抵消了巴西削弱带来的相对利好，维持基线不动。
key_reasons.en: Morocco's own losses (Aguerd and Ezzalzouli withdrew injured pre-tournament; En-Nesyri left out) offset the relative gain from Brazil's weakening, so Morocco stays at baseline.

method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11), no market input. Bounded evidence adjustment within ±4pp/team: Brazil -2pp (injury disruption), Scotland +2pp (intact squad), Morocco and Haiti unchanged (Morocco's own withdrawals offset Brazil's weakening); zero-sum transfer, probabilities sum to 1. Market-blind throughout.
